description: This file contains internal utility functions related to network host address validation within an Android context, specifically checking for loopback and private LAN gateways based on host strings and IP address parsing.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost
methods.description: Checks if a given host string refers to a loopback address (localhost or loopback IPs).

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines if the host string refers to a private LAN address or network segment.
